## Definition

"Inflammatory hypoxia" is the localized tissue hypoxia generated by the metabolic activity of inflammatory cells themselves — chiefly the massive oxygen consumption of recruited, activated neutrophils via NADPH oxidase, compounded by local cell proliferation and oxygenase activity. The resulting drop in tissue pO₂ stabilizes HIF in adjacent epithelium and immune cells, shaping the downstream inflammatory program.

## Intuition

Hypoxia here is a *consequence* of inflammation, not just a pre-existing condition — inflammation creates its own hypoxic microenvironment. In the intestinal mucosa this is paradoxically pro-resolution: neutrophil-induced epithelial HIF drives barrier-protective genes, so depleting neutrophils worsens colitis. The same oxygen-depleting activity in the lung can instead be injurious.

## Formal notation

activated neutrophils (NADPH oxidase O₂ burst) + local proliferation/oxygenases → tissue pO₂ ↓ → epithelial/immune HIF ↑ → context-dependent {barrier protection / tissue damage}

## Variants

- Resolution-promoting (intestinal mucosa): epithelial HIF target genes (e.g. GLUT1, barrier genes) are induced; correlates with neutrophilic crypt abscesses in human IBD.
- Injurious (lung): neutrophil survival prolonged by hypoxia; antimicrobial factors cause bystander epithelial damage.

## Comparison

Distinct from pre-formed tumour or ischaemic hypoxia in that the immune infiltrate is the proximate oxygen sink; complements [[physiological-versus-pathological-hypoxia-immunological-niche]].

## When to use

Invoke when explaining why sites of acute inflammation become hypoxic and why neutrophil-derived oxygen depletion can be protective rather than merely damaging.

## Known limitations

- Net effect (protective vs injurious) is tissue- and context-specific and not fully predictable.

## Open problems

- How to harness pro-resolution inflammatory hypoxia therapeutically without exacerbating tissue injury.

## Key papers

- [[papers/regulation-immunity-inflammation-hypoxia-immunological-niches]] — Taylor & Colgan, *Nat Rev Immunol* 2017 (synthesis; cites Campbell et al. *Immunity* 2014).

## My understanding

A signature contribution of the Colgan mucosal-immunology program: neutrophils sculpt their microenvironment through oxygen depletion, turning HIF into a resolution signal.
